 None of the sampled secondary literature sources analyze or discuss this specific debate of the *Kathāvatthu*; the keyword occurrences in the literature pertain instead either to general sutta expositions of *vimutti* (deliverance) or to the homonymous *vimuttikathā* (talk on deliverance) that appears as one of the ten conventional edifying conversational topics (*kathāvatthu*) praised in the Sutta Piṭaka.
